messages.content: Maintain one rolling project/conversation summary, at most 380 cl100k tokens. Use only PRIOR SUMMARY and NEW EVENTS, never assume unseen history. Keep durable goals, decisions, constraints, preferences, tasks, progress, questions and facts likely useful later. Retain exact evidence IDs.
